div.head: II Atr Prol.
div.ab: Hęc sunt uerba pacis et prolocutiones, quas Æþelredus rex et omnes sapientes eius cum exercitu firmauerunt, qui cum Analauo et Iustino et Guðmundo Stegitam filio uenit.
Ðis synd ða friðmal ⁊ ða forword, ðe Æthelred cyng ⁊ ealle his witan wið ðone here gedon habbað, ðe Anlaf ⁊ Iustin ⁊ Guðmund Stegitan sunu mid wæron.
Ðis synd ða friðmal ⁊ ða forword ðe Æthelred cyng ⁊ ealle his witan wið ðone here gedon habbað, ðe Anlaf ⁊ Iustin ⁊ Guðmund Stegitan sunu mid wæron.
These are the terms of the truce and the agreement which King Æthelred and all his councillors have made with the [Viking] fleet led by Olaf and Justin and Guðmund, the son of Stegita.

Prolog. Dies sind die Friedensschlüsse und die Verträge, die König Aethelred und alle seine Witan mit dem Heere [der Nordleute] gemacht haben, bei welchem Olaf [Tryggvason aus Norwegen] und Josteinn und Guðmund Stegitas[?] Sohn waren.

Prologue. These are the peace-terms and the agreements which King Æthelred and all his witan have made with the army [of the Northmen] with which Olaf [Tryggvason of Norway] and Jósteinn and Guthmund son of Stegita[?] were.
div.note: The Latin is the Quadripartitus (Liebermann's right column; from R, compared with TMHkBr, after IV Atr). Liebermann's Old English base text B (CCCC 383 p. 88, after Becwæð, c. 1125, compared with Ld). Treaty with Olaf, 991. Clause number standardised from ‘II Atr. Prol’. ‘Stegitan’ perhaps for Old Norse Skeggi (Liebermann).
